usedFor: Shopify holds the catalog, and HTML/CSS to Image makes pictures from markup through “Convert HTML/CSS to Image”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Convert HTML/CSS to Image” in HTML/CSS to Image
bestTemplate.why: A new product can be rendered as a PNG, JPEG or WebP image from markup or a public page.

watchOut: “Create Image Template” saves a reusable template, so make it once rather than on every new product.
